description: Unlocks further start_intake_demo sessions for this caller by capturing an email address. Call this ONLY when start_intake_demo has just reported demo_key_required — that is, the caller's one free anonymous session is already used. Ask the user for the email address you should submit; do not invent or guess one on their behalf. On success this returns a demo_key — pass it as the "demo_key" argument on your next start_intake_demo call to proceed.

email.description: The user's email address, given by the user, not invented.

name: request_demo_access
